definitions.explanation: an organizational unit within a company or institution

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{部署|ぶしょ}に{異動|いどう}した。
examples.english: I was transferred to a new department.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}の{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}が{集|あつ}まった。
この{案件|あんけん}はどの{部署|ぶしょ}が{担当|たんとう}していますか。
examples.english: Which department is in charge of this matter?

notes:
{部署|ぶしょ} refers to an organizational unit within a company or institution — a department, division, or assigned post.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部署|ぶしょ}{異動|いどう}: department transfer
- {部署|ぶしょ}を{移|うつ}る: to move to another department
- {各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}: each department
- {担当|たんとう}{部署|ぶしょ}: department in charge
- {配属|はいぞく}{部署|ぶしょ}: assigned department

COMPARISON OF ORGANIZATIONAL TERMS:
- {部署|ぶしょ}: organizational section, post (general)
- {部門|ぶもん}: division, field (broader scope)
- {課|か}: section (smaller unit within a {部|ぶ})
- {部|ぶ}: department (larger unit)
- {係|かかり}: unit, person in charge (smallest unit)

REGISTER:
Used in business and organizational contexts. Commonly heard in workplace conversations about transfers and responsibilities.
